description:
Apply Image > Adjustments > Brightness/Contrast once to the active layer. Values are deltas on pixels, not an adjustment layer.

Users often say: fix exposure, add contrast, brighten, darken.

Use when: a quick brightness/contrast pass on the current raster layer.
Do NOT use when: exposure in stops on an editable layer — use photoshop_adjust_exposure.
Do NOT use when: a non-destructive tonal curve — use photoshop_adjust_curves.
Do NOT use when: automatic black and white points — use photoshop_auto_levels.

Returns: the brightness and contrast values applied.
Preconditions: active document and active layer. Text and Smart Objects are rasterized first. Side effects: destructive pixels, one history step. Calling again applies another delta. Reversible with photoshop_undo.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_adjust_brightness_contrast
